note: Lessons townsfolk give when you ASK in chat (Robert, 2026-10-02: 'include training if it's available in chat, or make it discoverable through asking'). Each person teaches one thing, picked by role (and by name, so two villagers differ). Asking about training in chat (any of 'words') makes it known; from then on it's also a button in their menu. Once per person per day. Game.gd round-22 block.

strike_drill.name: a striking drill
strike_drill.pitch: how to put your whole weight behind your qi
strike_drill.desc: Drills your wired strike art (+12 practice) and shows you a glimpse of what comes after it.

step_drill.name: footwork
step_drill.pitch: footwork -- how to be somewhere else when the blow lands
step_drill.desc: Drills your wired step art (+12 practice) and a glimpse of the next one.

guard_drill.name: guard work
guard_drill.pitch: how to take a blow, and how to send one back
guard_drill.desc: Drills your guard art (+12 practice) -- or, with none, a long look at how a guard is held (glimpses of Iron Shell).

breath.name: a breathing lesson
breath.pitch: how to breathe so the qi comes to you instead of you chasing it
breath.desc: Your next 15 minutes of meditation run 1.4x, and your focus point gets a push.

weapon.name: weapon work
weapon.pitch: how to hold what you're holding
weapon.desc: A good deal of practice with the weapon in your hand.

swarm.name: nanite tinkering
swarm.pitch: how the old machines like to be handled
swarm.desc: Your swarm grows (+30 integration), and a hint of an augment you haven't found.
